newsitem.title: CHINA: China's central bank governor urges learn from HK.
newsitem.headline: China's central bank governor urges learn from HK.

text.p: China's central bank governor Dai Xianglong has urged finance officials to learn from their Hong Kong counterparts, the Financial Morning Post said on Tuesday.

Hong Kong was one of the world's top financial centres and with a well-run financial management system, advanced operating mechanisms and strict supervision system, the newspaper quoted Dai, president of the People's Bank of China as saying.

"We should make a serious study of the financial system of Hong Kong, borrow from their successful experience and make full use of Hong Kong's status as a international financial centre to accelerate the development of China's economy, it quoted Dai as saying.
Hong Kong reverts to Chinese rule at midnight on June 30, ending more than 150 years of British colonial administration.
